market_question: Will Trump and Putin meet next in another EU country?
reasoning: Trump has openly stated a desire to meet Putin to negotiate on Ukraine, and historical US-Russia summits often take place in EU countries (e.g., Helsinki 2018, Hamburg 2017). Even with talks of a possible Gulf state meeting, the chance that the next meeting occurs in an EU country is substantially above the 0.4% implied by the market, likely in the 5–10% range considering the window to mid-2026 and the unresolved war.
evidence_points: Trump repeatedly pledges to meet Putin soon to discuss Ukraine peace.
Previous Trump-Putin meetings in Helsinki (2018) and Hamburg (2017) show EU venues are precedented.
No confirmed location for a meeting, leaving many EU countries plausible.
sources_consulted: Recent news on Trump-Putin summit prospects
